name: Kotlin-Bench__full_file_gen__fs-oracle
description: A code-generation benchmark that evaluates full-file Kotlin source generation given problem specifications and an oracle filesystem. The benchmark measures whether generated files compile and pass provided tests, emphasizing end-to-end correctness of multi-file Kotlin programs. It is intended to assess models' ability to produce complete, runnable software artifacts rather than isolated snippets.
reputation: A specialized dataset on Hugging Face for Kotlin full-file generation; limited but growing use among code-generation researchers.
